standard-dialogue-before-completing-merl.npc: Hello there adventurer, what do you want of me?

standard-dialogue-before-completing-merl.player: I'd like some advice on finding a quest.

standard-dialogue-before-completing-merl.npc: I do not know of any myself... but it would perhaps be worth your while asking the King if he has any tasks for you.

standard-dialogue-after-completing-merli.npc: Hello there adventurer, what do you want of me?
After your help freeing Merlin, my help is the least I can offer as a man of honour.

standard-dialogue-after-completing-merli.player: Nothing right now, but I'll bear it in mind. Thanks.

standard-dialogue-after-completing-king-.npc: Hello there adventurer, what do you want of me?
I was glad to get my revenge on those knights in the keep. They were no match for us.

standard-dialogue-after-completing-king-.player: Makes you wonder how they kidnapped you in the first place.
